situation: Choosing between shipping a rough prototype now or a polished version next week.
call: Ship the rough prototype today and iterate fast based on real feedback.
reasons: Real feedback is worth more than polish at this stage.

provenance.quote: Ship it rough now — I can fix the polish, I can't fix wasted time.

situation: Deciding whether to keep a third-party logging library or write a minimal stdlib version.
reasons: No external deps is a hard factory rule.
The third-party lib does 90% more than we need.

provenance.quote: Cut the dep — stdlib is fine for what we actually need.

situation: Picking a visual layout for the onboarding screen: centered card vs full-bleed illustration.
reasons: Card feels like every other app.

provenance.quote: Go full-bleed — I want it to feel different from the first second.

situation: Someone asked if we should auto-save drafts every 30 seconds.
Deciding whether the app needs a dedicated settings screen at launch.
call: No settings screen at launch — embed the one option in the main view.
reasons: One option does not warrant its own screen.

provenance.quote: No settings screen — if there is only one knob, put it on the main screen.
